name: Kazu the Cassowary
storyline: Kazu sets out on a dangerous journey to rescue his parents after they are captured by the villainous Professor Vex Volt. Along the way, he must explore colorful environments, overcome platforming challenges, and confront Vex Volt’s schemes in order to bring his family home.
summary: Kazu the Cassowary is a 3D platformer in which Kazu sets out to rescue his parents from the villainous Professor Vex Volt. Explore colorful environments, overcome platforming challenges, and follow Kazu’s rescue adventure.
